question: I'm an IS sophomore (P-014) with a Data Science concentration and BA minor. If I take 70-122 (Introduction to Accounting), can it satisfy both a BA minor required course AND an IS free elective?

domain_contributions.programs: BA minor: 70-122 (Accounting) is a standard required BA minor course. IS degree: 70-122 could count as an IS free elective slot
domain_contributions.courses: 70-122 (Introduction to Accounting, 9 units) — foundational BA course with cross-program applicability

key_facts: 70-122 is listed as a core BA course and standard BA minor requirement
IS degree includes free elective slots that could accept 70-122
Double-counting policy: applying 70-122 to both BA minor (as a minor requirement) and IS degree (as a free elective) may be treated differently than satisfying two core requirements
Some institutions allow minor courses to also fill free elective slots in the major — CMU-Q policy on this needs verification
P-014's Stellic audit should show how 70-122 is currently categorized
